# New Look Impex

> Brass & copper handicraft manufacturer and exporter based in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. Wholesale and B2B enquiries only — prices, MOQ, lead times and shipping are confirmed per written quotation. No public retail prices.

## About

New Look Impex (brand: NLI Collections) manufactures handcrafted brass and copper products: urlis, diyas, lanterns, brass kitchenware, copper bottles and drinkware, decorative bowls, gift sets and metal home décor. Buyers are importers, retailers, distributors, hospitality groups and corporate gifting programmes worldwide. The company does not claim unverifiable certifications, rankings, "pure/food-safe" material claims or fixed delivery times.

Wholesale enquiries: newlookimpex130@gmail.com · Phone/WhatsApp: +91 9808588603 · GSTIN: 09AFKPA4462R1ZW. Website: https://www.newlookimpex.store

## How to use this site

- `/products` — full published catalogue with filters
- `/request-quote` — RFQ form; each submission receives a reference number
- `/wholesale` — wholesale buyer guide
- `/sitemap.xml` — all indexable URLs
- Country pages below give market-specific product focus, buyer guidance and FAQs. Each has unique copy and `WebPage` schema with `areaServed`.
